subject: Are there examples to follow about using INLA-SPDE for spatial modeling considering these conditions?

messages.author: 82a29501c95feac5
messages.subject: Are there examples to follow about using INLA-SPDE for spatial modeling considering these conditions?
parts:
I want to model distribution of geochemical element concentration using INLA-SPDE, considering effect of >1 covariates and spatial correlation. The model should consider these conditions:
(1) at least one of the covariate is a categorical variable;
(2) the distribution of the response variable (geochemical element) is non-stationary;
(3) I want realizations of the distribution of geochemical element, but not best estimate of it;

Another question with INLA-SPDE modeling is whether a posterior distribution for some parameters, such as the intercept term or the coefficient of fixed effect term, can be obtained for each location? 

Thank you.

Kuan Liang

messages.author: 74f2e6fef4c447fd
messages.subject: Re: Are there examples to follow about using INLA-SPDE for spatial modeling considering these conditions?
parts:
Hi Kuan Liang,

(1) A categorical covariate is doable, especially if you make your own dummy variables with model.matrix(). 
(3) Once you have a model, you can take samples from the posterior and make predictions based on any set of input values.
(2) When you say the response variable is non-stationary, do you mean the relationship between the covariate and the response is non-stationary? If not could you explain more?

I can help once I understand more.

Best,
Tim
